title: What we do | Plainsight Medical
desc: GEO-friendly websites, patient-education films, an AI presenter in your own voice, and social content managed across four platforms.

sections.text:
HOME
/
SERVICES
ONE PARTNER, FOUR crafts.
The website patients and AI assistants find, the films inside it, the presenter who is you, and the channels that carry it all. Each can be bought on its own, and they work best together.

01
GEO-FRIENDLY WEBSITES
A site built around your operations and your patients’ questions, and structured so that Google and AI assistants can read, check and quote it.
A page for each condition and procedure, with its film embedded
A profile that sets out your appointments, training and affiliations
Structured data, question-led pages and an llms.txt summary
Crawl rules that let search engines and AI assistants in
A regular check of what Google and the main assistants say about you
See a site for your specialty
02
PATIENT-EDUCATION FILMS
A film for each thing you explain most often, so patients arrive at consultation already understanding the basics.
Script drafted from current NHS, NICE and specialist sources, for your review
Anatomy animation, patient scenes, narration, music and captions
Embedded on your site with a full transcript and named sources
Any topic: from the library, from the topic list, or made to order
Your logo and colours, and a subtitle file for accessibility
Watch the 16 films in the library
03
YOUR AI PRESENTER
An AI clone of you presents each film with your own face and voice, so patients meet the consultant they are about to see.
A consent form signed before anything is recorded
One short recording session for your face and voice
Your clone on camera, and your voice narrating the whole film
Your presenter in the full film, the vertical version and the shorts
Used only for your approved content, and deleted on request
See the AI presenter working
04
SOCIAL CONTENT
Each film is cut for every platform, and your channels are managed so they all carry the same clinically approved message.
Every film reframed for vertical viewing and cut into shorts of 30 to 60 seconds.
Captions burned in for silent viewing, with your logo and colours.
Your AI presenter in every format, if you have one.
A posting plan agreed with you, and nothing published without your sign-off.
See the shorts and how social works

THREE TERMS, PLAINLY
SEO, AEO AND GEO ARE THREE WAYS OF BEING the answer.
The difference is where the patient is asking, and what counts as winning.
SEO
SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMISATION
“robotic hernia repair London”
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Your page appears in the list of results on Google or Bing.
WHAT IT TAKES
Fast pages, clear titles, pages that match what people search for, and other sites that link to you.
AEO
ANSWER ENGINE OPTIMISATION
“How long is recovery after gallbladder removal?”
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Your wording is shown as the answer itself: a featured snippet, a People Also Ask box, a voice reply.
WHAT IT TAKES
The question as a heading, a direct answer in the first sentence, and FAQ markup.
GEO
GENERATIVE ENGINE OPTIMISATION
“Who does robotic bile duct surgery near Harrow?”
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
An AI assistant such as ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity names you or cites your page in its reply.
WHAT IT TAKES
Consistent facts about who you are, sourced content, readable transcripts, and access for AI crawlers.

QUESTIONS
ASKED BEFORE every PROJECT.
What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?
Can you guarantee a first-page ranking or a mention by ChatGPT?
Who is responsible for the clinical content?
Are the people in the films real?
Can the films be presented by me?
Do you look after social media as well?
Do I need a new website to use the films?
Who owns the films?
How long does a film take?
How much does it cost?
Do you take account of the advertising rules for doctors?
